body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 8d5f04229d5c1fcb7718673ca729b34174df8108 -->
**Review of head `8d5f04229`: clean. No blocker.** A read-only Opus agent that did not write the change read it. A gate-runner that did not write the change ran it.

**Read.**
- **Test code only.** `gpu_test_lock` is `#[cfg(test)]`. Each other edit is one line in a `#[test]` function. No function of the product changes.
- **Guard lifetime.** `let _gpu = gpu_guard();` is the first statement of each of the eight tests, so the guard drops after the harness and its renderer. The kittest renderer is made only in `render()` or for a pending screenshot, and it lives in the harness.
- **Coverage.** No other lib test that runs by default reaches the GPU without the guard. Three `#[ignore]`d lib tests and two integration binaries (`trace_composite`, `trace_parity`) have no guard: follow-up #3605.
- **Lock.** No test takes the guard two times. The counter decrements in `Drop`, also on a panic. The source pin uses `include_str!`.
- **Rules.** The `#[test]` count goes up by 3. No snapshot, no dependency. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Refs #3589`, and no closing keyword.

**Independent run** on this head (main `35e3bd173` is an ancestor of the head):
- `camcraft-ui` lib, two full runs: 1484 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored, each. No `0xc0000005`.
- The three pin tests by filter: 3 passed.
- clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings`: clean.

**Limit.** This machine did not show the fault before the change. The proof is the repeat runs of the reporter on #3589. The issue stays open.

Merge note. Class: no refresh (head `8d5f04229` merged unchanged as `0839e979e`). Basis: the review with the marker on this head and the independent runs (two full `camcraft-ui` lib runs, 1484 passed, 0 failed). The change is test code only. #3589 stays open until its reporter confirms.
